reason: Test describes standard date formatting behavior where a single 'Y' outputs a literal 'Y' character; this is expected behavior in most date formatting libraries unless a breaking change specifically altered token parsing.
Duplicate of js_0001; same reasoning applies - single 'Y' pattern should output literal letter in standard date formatting implementations.
Percent-encoded path parameter decoding is standard web framework behavior; the test expects correct decoding which is the default correct implementation.
Duplicate of js_0011; percent-decoding of route parameters is fundamental routing behavior expected to work correctly.
Job rescheduling updating the in-memory handle is a typical design pattern for job queue libraries; test expects correct mutation behavior which is standard.
Duplicate of jvm_0003; same reasoning - in-memory handle update after reschedule is expected behavior.
Content-Type header parsing with charset parameter is a well-established HTTP standard; libraries correctly parse 'text/plain; charset=UTF-8' into type/subtype/charset.
Duplicate of jvm_0007; Content-Type parsing with charset is standard HTTP behavior.
Composer archive preserving file modification timestamps in zip is documented expected behavior; test validates correct timestamp preservation.
Re-archiving consistency is expected for deterministic builds; Composer's archive should produce identical timestamps across runs.
Async JSON deserialization with nullable parent property is standard System.Text.Json behavior; large arrays with nullable refs deserialize correctly.
Sync and async deserialization producing equivalent results is a correctness guarantee of System.Text.Json; nullable parent property doesn't change this.
CockroachDB INET <<= ANY operator with subnets is standard PostgreSQL-compatible syntax; '192.168.1.5' contained in '192.168.1.0/24' returns true.
CockroachDB INET >>= ANY with array syntax is standard; '10.0.0.0/8' contains '10.1.2.3' so query returns true.
HTTP client construction with NO_PROXY='::1' (IPv6 loopback) is valid proxy exclusion; standard libraries handle IPv6 addresses in NO_PROXY correctly.
Duplicate of py_0001; IPv6 loopback in NO_PROXY is valid and client construction should succeed.
Regex 'dot matches newline' option (re.DOTALL) making '.' match newlines is standard Python re behavior; both inline and compiled patterns work equivalently.
Duplicate of py_0003; DOTALL flag behavior is consistent between pattern string and compiled regex.
Celery chain serialization with parallel groups preserving all task results on reconstruction is expected behavior for result backend serialization.
Duplicate of rg_0001; chain result serialization round-trip should preserve all task results.
Command-line parsing with trailing '--' handing off to later positional is standard argparse/click behavior; '--' terminates first positional, remaining go to second.
Duplicate of rg_0005; double-dash delimiter behavior is well-defined in CLI parsing libraries.
Neovim OSC 11 background color change triggering OptionSet and ColorScheme autocommands is documented terminal integration behavior.
Duplicate of rgf_0009; terminal background change via OSC 11 fires the expected autocommands.
Required field validation flagging changeset invalid when mandatory field omitted is core Ecto/ActiveRecord behavior; validation correctly catches missing required fields.
Duplicate of sa_0007; required field validation on changeset is fundamental ORM behavior.
